# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Urgot with a custom-made model after [Houseplant](https://twitter.com/plantedplanty)'s original concept for PROJECT: Urgot. Please check out his great work and support!

## CREDITS

* To view all of the collaborator **CREDITS** on this skin, visit [https://projecturgot.carrd.co/](https://projecturgot.carrd.co/)  [ ](https://www.artstation.com/siaosia)

## EXTRA INFOS

* This mod was created in collaboration with Urpog's team. If you appreciate Urpog for making this skin possible, please consider following his content on [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCi1dkcQuuH6FBx2zd8qwolw) and [Twitch](https://twitter.com/Urpog1) and becoming a supporter.
* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!

In-Game Showcase [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2oVYB255Uok](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2oVYB255Uok)

Enjoy!
